_doc: Matched-wall-clock control for H36 stage 4, on both primary datasets. Control = the champion's OWN move class (more under-relaxed sift sweeps). Treatment = the shipped stage-4 block/node alternation. Same starting order, same machine, matched wall-clock, 0 gradient steps in both arms.
conclusion: On BOTH primaries, at matched wall-clock from the same starting order, the champion's own single-node move class recovers a small fraction of what the block move class recovers. The gain is the move class, not the compute.
